translationResources.title: ResponsiveGrid
translationResources.description: An equal-column grid whose column count follows its own width (container queries), not the viewport.

basic.title: Responsive columns
basic.description: columns accepts base / sm / md / lg counts for 0, 480, 768 and 1200px of available width.

full-width.title: Full-width items
full-width.description: GridItem fullWidth spans the row; rowGap and columnGap are independent.

ResponsiveGridProps.ref: Ref to the outer (query container) element
ResponsiveGridProps.as: Element or component rendered as the outer container (div, section, nav...)
ResponsiveGridProps.columns: Column counts (integers 1-12): a number, or { base, sm, md, lg } for 480 / 768 / 1200px; other values throw a RangeError
ResponsiveGridProps.gap: Gap between rows and columns (spacing token or CSS value)
ResponsiveGridProps.rowGap: Gap between rows; defaults to gap
ResponsiveGridProps.columnGap: Gap between columns; defaults to gap

GridItemProps.ref: Ref to the item element (or to the slotted child with asChild)
GridItemProps.fullWidth: Spans the full row of the surrounding grid
GridItemProps.asChild: Merges the item props, classes and ref into its single child instead of rendering a wrapper div

cssVars.--responsive-grid-align-items: Vertical alignment of the items in their row (default: stretch)
cssVars.--responsive-grid-justify-items: Horizontal alignment of the items in their column (default: stretch)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: columns="1 2 3 4" sets the column count for the base, sm, md and lg container widths; the grid follows its own width, not the viewport.

container.title: Container breakpoints
container.description: columns also accepts JSON ({"base": 1, "sm": 2, "lg": 4}; missing breakpoints inherit the previous one) and row-gap / column-gap split the gap. Drag the slider to resize the container.

full-width.title: Full-width items
full-width.description: Wrap a child in <minerva-grid-item full-width> to span the whole row.
